item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00233","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C06","C18","C16"],"selected_candidate_label":"C06","confidence":0.96,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C06 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. Both letters identify a population-specific problem requiring a coordinated, government-wide response; emphasize fuller use of existing federal resources or programs; and announce a multi-department body intended to coordinate agencies and improve services. The unusually close pairing of “coordinated Federal approach” with “full utilization of existing resources” in C06 and “full coordination” with “maximum utilization of existing programs and agencies” in the child is distinctive and material. C18 and C16 also use interdepartmental coordination machinery, but their language and operative structure are less closely matched.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Our basic approach has been (1) to place maximum emphasis on individual freedom and responsibility, and (2) to seek maximum utilization of existing programs and agencies.","parent_excerpt":"A coordinated Federal approach and a full utilization of existing resources will make possible more effective action in the solution of migratory labor problems.","explanation":"The child closely reuses C06’s formulation linking federal coordination, full use of existing governmental resources, and more effective action on a population-specific social problem."},{"child_excerpt":"In order to insure full coordination of the activities of these Departments and Agencies, I am establishing shortly a Federal Council on Aging.","parent_excerpt":"As you have suggested, I am establishing an Interdepartmental Committee on Migratory Labor made up of the Secretaries of the Interior, Agriculture, Labor, and Health, Education, and Welfare and the Administrator of the Housing and Home Finance Agency.","explanation":"Both announce a newly established interdepartmental body whose central purpose is coordinating multiple departments and agencies around the needs of a defined population."},{"child_excerpt":"This Council, comprised of representatives of 12 Departments and Agencies, will be of great value in achieving a more effective Government-wide approach to the needs of our older citizens.","parent_excerpt":"It is my hope that this Committee will aid the various Federal agencies in mobilizing and stimulating more effective programs and services for migrants and in providing service to State and local areas through their constituent members.","explanation":"The same administrative mechanism—an interagency council or committee—is presented as the means to improve government-wide programs and services for the target group."}]}
